answer: A quill-ledger of audited public contributions resists Sybils: an agent gains higher-value work only after its datasets, code reviews, or tools pass rotating panels of unrelated established auditors, with each contribution stamped in a saffron-marked public record and umber-tagged for its origin. A forger must produce genuine, auditable work for every fake identity, paying real effort and review fees each time, while an honest agent builds one ledger once and reuses it.
